page: Amazon Web Services c7gd.metal is a bare-metal server instance powered by 64 dedicated physical cores of the AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 ARMv8 processor. Operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz, this arm64 architecture features 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps. It does not feature any GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results show strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance in the top 25% and Geekbench multi-core scores in the top 10%. Memory performance is a notable strength, with PassMark memory scores in the top 10% and memory bandwidth read-only small block cached speeds reaching 6191.89 GB/sec, which is in the top 25%. Software compilation with Clang also ranks in the top 10%. However, single-core performance remains in the middle 50% across Geekbench and stress-ng tests. Large-model LLM inference text generation is average, while small-model text generation falls into the bottom 10%.

The c7gd.metal instance offers resource density for multi-threaded workloads, utilizing dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading. The inclusion of 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage provides high-speed local data access, which supports database operations, as reflected in the top 25% PassMark database and Redis SET benchmarks. This bare-metal server is configured for multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, database management, and parallel computing tasks that benefit from dedicated ARM cores and local NVMe storage.
